message.content:
**Short answer:**  
Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.  The city’s *Police Department* (and the *Code Enforcement* office) handle most noise‑related issues, and you can submit a complaint online, by phone, or in person.  The City Council itself does not take individual noise complaints, but it can refer you to the right department or help if the problem persists.

---

## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Method | What to do | Contact / Link |
|--------|------------|----------------|
| **Online form** | Fill out the official “Noise Complaint” form and submit it electronically. | [Noise Complaint Form (PDF)](https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2023-02/Noise%20Complaint%20Form.pdf) – download, fill, and email to **noisecomplaint@atlantaga.gov** |
| **Phone (non‑emergency)** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line. | **404‑656‑4000** |
| **311 (City of Atlanta)** | Dial 311 (or use the 311 app) and request a noise complaint. | **311** (within Atlanta) |
| **In person** | Visit the City Hall or the Police Department’s traffic/noise unit. | City Hall: 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |
| **Mail** | Send a written complaint to the Police Department. | 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### What Information to Provide

1. **Your contact details** (name, address, phone, email).  
2. **Date & time** of the noise incident(s).  
3. **Location** (street address or intersection).  
4. **Description of the noise** (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).  
5. **Any evidence** (photos, audio recordings, witness statements).  
6. **How long the problem has been occurring** (one-time vs. ongoing).  

Providing as much detail as possible helps the officers or code‑enforcement officers investigate quickly.

---

## Relevant Atlanta Noise Ordinance

- **Title:** *Atlanta Noise Ordinance* (Title 10, Chapter 3 of the Atlanta Municipal Code).  
- **Key points:**  
  - Prohibits “excessive or unreasonable” noise during certain hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.).  
  - Applies to residential, commercial, and industrial sources.  
  - Violations can result in citations, fines, or, in extreme cases, criminal charges.  
- **Full text:** [Atlanta Municipal Code – Noise Ordinance](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/police-department/traffic-and-noise-ordinance)

---

## If the Issue Persists

1. **Follow up**: If you haven’t heard back within a week, call the Police Department or the Code Enforcement office.  
2. **Escalate**: For repeated or severe violations, you can contact your **City Council Member**.  
   - Find your council member: [City Council Members](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council)  
   - Phone: **404‑656‑4000** (City Hall) or the member’s office number.  
3. **Legal action**: In extreme cases, you may consult an attorney or file a civil complaint, but most noise problems are resolved through city enforcement.

---

### Quick Reference

| Resource | Link / Phone |
|----------|--------------|
| City of Atlanta website | https://www.atlantaga.gov |
| Atlanta Police Department | 404‑656‑4000 |
| Noise Complaint form | https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2023-02/Noise%20Complaint%20Form.pdf |
| 311 (City of Atlanta) | 311 |
| City Council Members | https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council |
| Noise Ordinance | https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/police-department/traffic-and-noise-ordinance |

---

**Bottom line:**  
You can definitely report a noise complaint in Atlanta.  Use the online form, call 311, or dial the Police Department’s non‑emergency line.  The city’s enforcement agencies will investigate and take action if the noise violates the municipal ordinance.
